rolls = rng.integers(
    1, 7, size=(100_000, 2)
).sum(axis=1)
(rolls >= 10).mean()
# 0.1653   exact: 6/36 = 0.1667
caption: Repeat the experiment, then count.

code:
vals = rng.lognormal(3.5, 0.6,
                     size=(days, 50))
ret = rng.random((days, 50)) < 0.3
kept = np.where(ret, 0, vals).sum(1)
kept.mean()               # 1389.0
np.percentile(kept, 5)    # 1073.3
(kept < 1000).mean()      # 0.0176
caption: Illustrative: 50 orders a day, 30% returned.
